communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting the complete administrative file, processing notes, correspondence, and all responsive records associated with closed CIA FOIA Case Number F-2008-00988 (originally opened on March 19, 2008). Because this request targets a specific, previously processed administrative file case number rather than an open-ended subject search, it does not require new search parameters or database queries. Please pull the existing file folder directly from your archives. If any portion of this administrative file is withheld under a statutory exemption, please provide a detailed Vaughn Index listing the specific exemptions applied to each redaction or withheld page.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Michael A Duplantier
